brand.name: QP Helper
onboard.title: Welcome to QP Helper
onboard.sub: Quam Plus AI Research Integration System
onboard.note: Enter your name for audit tagging (no password needed).
chat.welcome: Hi, {name}, How can I help you?
chat.sys_intro: Ask a question about your knowledge base. Answers are grounded in retrieved documents with citations.
chat.cleared: Chat cleared. Ask a new question.
chat.offline: RAG service is not running. Start it from Settings.
chat.copied_msg:
Context package copied to clipboard!

Paste it into WorkBuddy for deep analysis.
chat.kb_warn: Model warmup failed; will load on first question.
chat.kb_not_ready: Knowledge base is still loading. Please wait a moment.
at.pick_folder_title: Select a folder to scope the question
at.pick_file_title: Select a file to scope the question
at.scope_hint: To scope the question to a folder/file, use the @ menu -> Ask about folder / Ask about file (a picker dialog will let you choose). A manually typed @source carries no path, so this message was sent as a normal question.
at.search_empty: Please type what to search after '{cmd}'.
at.summary_notfound: No email file found for {date}; cannot summarize.
at.summary_empty: Fetched {date}, but Outlook returned 0 matching emails (date may be too old, or you need to re-login to Outlook).
report.bad_dir_root: Cannot save to drive root {path}. Please choose a folder under it (e.g. {path}Reports).
report.bad_dir: Selected output folder is invalid or does not exist: {path}
report.no_holdings: No holdings CSV set; the report will skip holdings validation (set it in Settings → Holdings).
chat.title: chat.title
skill.no_reply: No agent reply to export yet.
skill.github_prompt: Enter GitHub URL (file, folder, or repo):
db.empty_kb: Knowledge base is empty. Use "New" to create a folder or upload files.
db.upload_title: Upload file(s) and add to AI knowledge base
db.upload_done: Uploaded {n} file(s) into the knowledge base ({chunks} chunks).
db.upload_skipped: {n} file(s) skipped (unsupported type or read error).
db.drop_hint: Drop files here to upload to the database
db.confirm_delete_tag: Delete tag "{name}"? It will be removed from all files.
db.pick_folder: Select a folder on the left to view its files
db.confirm_delete_folder: Delete folder "{name}" and ALL its files? This cannot be undone.
db.clipboard_empty: Clipboard is empty — copy a file first.
db.ingest_kb_missing: Knowledge base root does not exist: {path}
db.selection_mode_tip: Toggle multi-select for batch actions (remove from DB / folder / tags)
db.confirm_remove_db: Remove the vector data of "{name}" from the knowledge base? The local file is kept and auto-sync will no longer re-import it.
db.confirm_remove_db_multi: Remove vector data of {n} file(s) from the knowledge base? Local files are kept and auto-sync will no longer re-import them.
db.confirm_remove_folder: Delete "{name}" and its local file (also clears its vectors from the KB)? This cannot be undone.
db.confirm_remove_folder_multi: Delete {n} file(s) and their local files (also clears vectors from the KB)? This cannot be undone.
db.removed_db_done: Removed {n} file(s) from the database (local files kept).
db.confirm_remove_folder_db: Remove folder "{name}" and all its sub-folders from the knowledge base? Local files are kept; auto-sync and Ingest KB will skip this folder.
db.removed_folder_db_done: Removed folder "{name}" ({files} file(s)) from the database.
db.remove_folder_db_fail: Failed to remove folder from database
pm.empty: No prompts yet. Use "New" to add one.
st.rag_behavior_desc: Control when the agent searches the knowledge base.
st.auto_retrieve: Auto-retrieve from KB on every message
st.agent_desc: System prompt / investment philosophy loaded by the agent on startup.
st.holdings_desc: UCITS fund holdings CSV. The agent validates the 23–27 holding count against it.
st.shared_root_desc: Team-shared root for knowledge base, prompts, upload log, agent config and holdings.
st.browse_hint: Click to choose the shared folder
st.service_error_no_python: Unable to start RAG service: bundled Python interpreter (.venv) not found. Please make sure the QP_Helper folder is intact (including the .venv subfolder).
st.saved_push: LLM config saved and pushed to the RAG service.
st.saved_no_push: LLM config saved. Start the RAG service to apply.
st.agent_saved: Agent config saved. Restart the RAG service to apply.
st.outlook_desc: Clear saved Outlook browser sessions so the next email fetch starts fresh. Useful when switching accounts or sharing the app with a colleague.
st.clear_outlook_fail:
Failed to clear some Outlook data:
{failed}
st.clear_outlook_none: No saved Outlook login data found.
startup.no_api_msg:
No LLM API key is configured.

Go to Settings → API Configuration to enter your key, base URL and model. The app will remember these for next time.
em.info: Opens Outlook via Edge and scrapes research emails for the selected date. Click “Start Fetching” — on the first run a browser window opens for you to sign in; the login is remembered afterward. Emails are saved and auto-ingested into the KB.
em.not_found: No email JSON file found. Run fetch first.
em.login_first: This is your first fetch. A browser window will open automatically — please sign in to Outlook there. The app continues on its own once you are logged in. Your login is saved for next time (clear it in Settings).
em.login_window_open: The browser window has opened. Please complete the Outlook login; fetching continues automatically afterward.
em.ready_again: Done — change the date and click Start Fetching again, or click Reset to clear the log.
